verdict.rationale: The only product-native background automation in the evidence is contractor invoice auto-pay [remote-docs-25], a narrow single-purpose rule rather than general user-configurable automations. Webhooks, the CLI, the MCP server and agent skills are developer building blocks for users to build their own automations, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general automation/workflow builder, scheduled or triggered autonomous jobs, agentic background execution, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of auto-pay's configuration and behavior.
